items.desc: Necessary material for evolving wind-type Aniimo. A peculiar rock containing the power of Wind Element. It’s so light that you can easily toss it far away. When holding it near the ear, you can hear the gentle whisper of wind.

sources.note: 2 per clear in Turbo Territory.

items.name: Loam Stone
items.desc: Necessary material for evolving earth-type Aniimo. A peculiar rock containing the power of Earth Element. It came from the soil beneath an ancient forest untouched by sunlight, full of the essence of the earth, symbolizing the endless cycle of life and growth.

sources.note: 2 per clear in Minespine Territory.

items.name: Night Stone
items.desc: Necessary material for evolving dark-type Aniimo. A peculiar rock containing the power of Dark Element. The black mysterious rock seems to have the ability of swallowing light.

sources.note: 2 per clear in Stellarys Territory.

items.name: Roar Stone
items.desc: Necessary material for evolving lightning-type Aniimo. A peculiar rock containing the power of Lightning Element. The surface is covered with winding patterns like a bolt of lightning, you can almost see sparks of electricity flickering around.

sources.note: 2 per clear in Blazen Territory.

items.name: Sprout Stone
items.desc: Necessary material for evolving grass-type Aniimo. A peculiar rock containing the power of Grass Element. The fresh scent and its green luster remind people of a vibrant and endless prairie.

sources.note: 2 per clear in Irisal Territory.

items.name: Unbroken Flameruff Spirit
items.desc: A piece of the burning spirit of a Flameruff fighter that ignites relentless determination in Flameruffs. To grow stronger, to rise above all—this is the Emberpups’ birthright. The fiercest Flameruffs battle in the Thousand-Fang Ridge, seeking to transcend their limits and claim the title of Scorchhowl. But victory is rare. Defeated, their bodies become Ridgeback Trees, while their spirits linger, tormented by the strength they could never grasp.

items.name: Wave Stone
items.desc: Necessary material for evolving water-type Aniimo. A peculiar rock containing the power of Water Element. The wave-like ripples on its surface make it very slippery, especially when you try to hold on to it.

sources.note: 2 per clear in Panpanta Territory.

items.name: Light Stone
items.desc: Necessary material for evolving light-type Aniimo. A peculiar rock containing the power of Light Element. The shiny, warm rock seems to have the ability to dispel darkness.

items.name: Star Stone
items.desc: Consumes this item and 1 of each of the following to craft 1 Starcryst Essence: Blaze Stone, Wave Stone, Gust Stone, Freeze Stone, Roar Stone, Loam Stone, Sprout Stone, and Night Stone. A meteorite sealed with stellar gifts, holding echoes left behind when a mighty Aniimo returned to the stars. Only by gathering elemental power can you break its confinement and unleash a blessing from afar.

items.name: Morph Orb
items.desc: Use on an Aniimo to change it into any other form except Prismana Form. Requires that you have previously obtained that form for this type of Aniimo. Crafted by the Polaris Institute based on Prismana Orbs to research the environment’s influence on Aniimo forms. Aniimo can harness its energy to alter their forms.

items.name: Lumin Crystals
items.desc: A brilliantly shining gem used to buy items from the Shop. An object born at the very beginning, when the Aeons created Idyll, whose brilliant radiance has never faded through the ages.

sources.note: 1 Radiant Waveglow per trade at the Shop · Outfits.

items.name: Report Card(s)
items.desc: A certificate issued by Polaris Institute. Enhances passive talents. Use in the [Character] > [Talents] menu. A reward given for completing your studies. It is the proof of your excellence in a professional field.

items.name: Aniimo EXP
items.desc: Grants Aniimo EXP and raises Aniimo level. Every point of EXP becomes energy for an Aniimo’s growth.

items.name: Research Points
items.desc: Obtain by unlocking new Aniimo research. Accumulate these to improve Research progress for the corresponding Aniimo.

items.name: Demo Tape
items.desc: A certificate issued by Polaris Institute. Enhances active skills. Use in the [Character] > [Talents] menu. Skill guidance provided by Polaris Institute. The recordings contain complete practical demonstrations, specially designed for talented Pathfinders.

items.name: Ancient Idyll Coin
items.desc: Used to buy accessories from Idyll vendors. Ancient coins from a lost civilization. Once used across markets and trade routes, they bear witness to a prosperous past.

items.name: Home Coin
items.desc: Use in your Home to upgrade your RV, purchase plots, and buy and upgrade production facilities. You may sell materials produced from Home and items foraged in the World at the Co-op Store in exchange for Home Coins. GoGoHomes’ exclusive token, each of which is engraved with a symbol representing "home" on its surface.

items.name: Bud Ticket
items.desc: Use in Home Shop to purchase decorative furniture. Aniimo placed in the Homebuilding Zone will produce this item. Little stars formed from the wishes and imagination of Aniimo. GoGoHomes designer Yama is collecting them so the dreams within their starlight can slowly come true in your Home.

sources.note: 1 Level 5 RV Welcome Pack per trade at the Shop (Homeland Gift Pack).
1 Level 8 RV Welcome Pack per trade at the Shop (Homeland Gift Pack).
1 Prismatic Stone - Fenmane per trade at the Shop (Homeland Gift Pack).
1 Prismana Crystal per trade at the Shop (Homeland Gift Pack).

items.desc: Use to purchase items in the Egg Heist Shop. Use to purchase Gear, Imprints, Eggs, Keys, and other items in the Egg Heist Shop.

1 Heavy Duty Backpack per trade at the Shop (Hot).

1 Protective Unit - Endurance per trade at the Shop (Black Market).

items.name: Quick Training Pass
items.desc: A special pass for Holo-Battle Sim. Use it to access Quick Training.

items.name: Rift Beacon
items.desc: Activate inside a Vein Rift to lure out a Legendary Aniimo, helping Pathfinders venture deeper. A guiding token forged from the energy of a Vein Rift. It holds the power released at the birth of a Legendary Aniimo, enough to awaken the instincts of its kind and draw them in.

items.name: Lumin Amber
items.desc: Amber infused with Lumin Power. Branches can absorb its energy to grow. These highly pure energy ambers originated from the overflowing Vein energy and have been refined over the ages. The power they contain is so intense that it can illuminate the surroundings, which earned it the name Lumin.

items.name: Prismana Crystal
items.desc: A crystal infused with Prismana that immediately triggers a Prismana Flow event when absorbed by the Branch. A pure crystal that has absorbed Prismana, naturally faceted like a prism and refracting magical, dreamlike light.

sources.note: 1 per Branch level: 1 over levels 6–6.
1 per Branch level: 1 over levels 6–6.

items.name: Fire Sprout Biscuit
items.desc: Use at a Bloom to nurture the ecosystem and attract Sparkelves. These crisp-baked Flame Cookies are filled with the maker’s care and hopes. Their heartfelt warmth surpasses their sweet aroma, luring nearby Sparkelves to gather around you.

items.name: Arena Points
items.desc: A straightforward way to show your records in the Arena.

items.name: Windrise Stamp
items.desc: Earned by playing various modes. Can be spent in the Stamp Shop to exchange for a variety of rewards. A season stamp issued by Polaris Institute, awarded to Pathfinders who deliver outstanding performance throughout the season.

items.name: Windchaser Stamp
items.desc: Earned by playing various modes. Can be spent in the Stamp Shop to exchange for a variety of rewards. A season-exclusive Stamp issued by Polaris Institute to recognize Pathfinders who delivered outstanding performance during the season.

items.name: Fashion Voucher
items.desc: Use to exchange for desired items with the Trendsetter in Astra . Whether you’re pursuing trendy outfits or unique accessories, Fashion Vouchers can fulfill your wishes.

items.name: Training Coin
items.desc: Digital currency that looks like gold coins. Use them to buy items for the Holo-Battle Sim.

items.name: Training Points
items.desc: Proof of hard training. Use them to buy items from the training shop.

items.name: Training EXP
items.desc: Reward for hard training. Can be used to increase Training Mastery.

items.name: Legendary Aniipod: Windchase Departure
items.desc: Windchase Departure season-exclusive Aniipod. When used, catching an Aniimo is guaranteed to succeed, its Potential is Perfect , and it will always be Sparkling , with the season-exclusive Sparkling effect of Windchase Departure. A special Aniipod crafted using the energy extracted from Irisalis petals. Blessed by the Irisalis, it can attract rare Aniimo.

items.name: Habi-Cube
items.desc: Use to obtain a Habi-Cube. Expand the function button area to find the Habi-Cube entrance, or use the shortcut [O] to open it. Train Aniimo in the Habi-Cube to gain Aniimo EXP . Feeding increases Bond and Acquired Potential , while exercise increases Bond and Aptitudes .

items.name: Egg
items.desc: Use in the Outpost Hatchinators to hatch an unknown type of Aniimo. Legend has it, when some powerful Aniimo depart, their souls transform into stars, slowly giving rise to these radiant, starlit eggs. They descend upon the world each night, carried by dazzling meteor showers.

items.name: Star Sand
items.desc: Used in Capability Awakening to increase an Aniimo’s Acquired Potential. The fallen star returns to the earth, and its glittering fragments hold a gentle power.

sources.note: 1 per clear in Stellarys, Scorchhowl, Panpanta, Blazen, Irisal, Turbo and Minespine Territory.

items.name: Starcryst Essence
items.desc: An extremely rare crystal used to increase an Aniimo’s Acquired Potential. A rare crystal formed in the distant past when the power left by ancient legendary Aniimo, now become stars in the night sky, returned to earth as stardust. Time and space turned; the stars came back to the land, and those distant blessings condensed into essence to bless new life.

sources.note: 1 Starcryst Essence in 20 % of dispatch rewards.
Listed among the chest's rewards; the game shows no rates.
One of its 3 pick-one bundles includes 2 Starcryst Essence.

items.name: Star Shard
items.desc: Collect 10 Star Shards to exchange for 1 Starcryst Essence at an outpost vendor. The scattered fragments of the fallen star still glimmer with faint starlight, and within them lingers a trace of mysterious power.

sources.note: 3 per clear in Stellarys, Scorchhowl, Panpanta, Blazen, Irisal, Turbo and Minespine Territory.
Listed among the chest's rewards; the game shows no rates.

items.desc: Use on Helion or Lunara to enhance their core skill.

items.desc: Use on Fulmintis to enhance their core skill.

items.name: Prismatic Stone - Fenmane
items.desc: Use on Fenmane to enhance their Core Skill.

items.name: Phenomena Crystal
items.desc: Used for ascending high-tier Aniimo during training. Greatly boosts overall strength and adds extra six-potential stats. A marvelous crystal bound to no single form. Its gentle, all-embracing glow can soothe the energy turbulence caused when a living being pushes past its limits.

sources.note: Always includes 1 Phenomena Crystal.

items.name: Sunny Daisy
items.desc: Yellow flowers with petals that shine brilliantly when illuminated. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Lunar Daisy
items.desc: White petals that appear to contain inner light, like tiny stars scattered across the surface. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Azure Grass
items.desc: Dense clusters of blue flowers forming perfect spherical blooms. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Red Cap
items.desc: Subtly growing red fungi with caps as vivid as burning flames. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Orange Cap
items.desc: Orange fungi that seem to have captured the sun’s essence, with caps as smooth and polished as amber. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Blue Cap
items.desc: Radiating mysterious deep blue light, with caps that shimmer with a Water-like luster. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Glintstone
items.desc: Large mineral ore found in Pebbling Cave. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Glintstone Shard
items.desc: Small mineral ore found in Pebbling Cave. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Truffle
items.desc: Delicious mushroom found in Mistwoods. Can be sold in the Inventory or at the Co-op Store for Home Coins.

items.name: Starine
items.desc: Place it in an Aniimo nest somewhere in the Forest of Falling Stars for a chance at something magical. Can be sold in the inventory for Credits. Fruit of a Starine Tree. Celestis family’s favorite food.

sources.note: In 157 chests across Beast Fang Ridge, Forest of Falling Stars and The Argent Strait.

items.name: Large Starine
items.desc: Place it in an Aniimo nest somewhere in the Forest of Falling Stars for a chance at something magical. A certain Stellarys living in the Forest of Falling Stars loves collecting these huge and rare Starines.

sources.note: In 12 chests across Forest of Falling Stars.

items.name: Mutant Truffle
items.desc: A rare special mushroom from Mistwoods containing unique energy

sources.note: In 30 chests across The Mistwoods.
1 Sprout Stone per trade at the Shop (Black Truffle Shop).
1 Night Stone per trade at the Shop (Black Truffle Shop).
16 Breezy Plains Dewdrop Crystal per trade at the Shop (Black Truffle Shop).

items.name: Ferric Charstone
items.desc: High-quality iron infused with mineral energy. Can be used to help certain Aniimo evolve. High-quality iron with a metallic sheen. Helmut and Jawling can absorb the iron element within to strengthen themselves.

sources.note: In 36 chests across Driftwise Meadow and Russet Highlands.

items.name: Charstone
items.desc: A rock fragment containing a small amount of mineral energy. Can be used to help certain Aniimo evolve. Charred rock formed by the flames of certain Aniimo. Charstone fragments can also be obtained while mining Ferric Charstone.

sources.note: In 33 chests across Driftwise Meadow and Russet Highlands.

items.name: Coral Branch
items.desc: Reefish mimics often seek peace and quiet among coral branches that resemble them. Fresh branches naturally shed from coral clusters. Their vivid offshoots contain the natural pigments favored by Popapus. Reefish are captivated by the satisfying crunch when biting into them and often use the branches to file down their teeth.

items.name: Sparkling Sigil
items.desc: Use to transform an Aniimo into a Sparkling Aniimo. Can also be exchanged at the Outpost Vendor for Sparkling Pigments. A mark wrapped in a strange glow. It holds the special energy needed to grant an Aniimo the Sparkling mutation.

sources.note: 1 Sparkling Pigment per trade at the Outpost vendor (Item Exchange), The Argent Strait.

events.title: Vein Abundance
events.intro: Beast Fang Ridge’s Vein energy is running high, drawing special Prismana Aniimo, who will appear when the Prismana Flow arrives!
rules: 1. According to the Institute's observations, Vein energy has been unusually active in certain areas recently. During the event, Nova Stage Aniimo are more likely to appear during your first 3 uses of Nurture.

dates.name: Vein Abundance: Forest of Falling Stars

events.title: Set Out, Pathfinder!
events.intro: Welcome to Idyll! Claim your starter rewards and begin your adventure!
rules: 1. During the event, log in to the game each day to complete that day’s check-in and earn rewards based on your cumulative check-in count.
2. The daily check-in count resets at 04:00 (UTC+0). Check in for a total of 7 days to claim all rewards.

events.title: Prismana Pact
events.intro: Ten years ago, during the Bloom Festival’s Prismana Flow, the Institute was fortunate enough to preserve several Prismana Aniimo. With the Institute’s careful care, they’ve grown up to this day, waiting to meet the very best Pathfinder. Go choose one. It is destined to walk beside you on the journeys ahead.
rules: 1. During the event, Pathfinders can pick one Prismana Aniimo they like on the event screen. Once your title is promoted to Junior Wayfarer, you can claim the Aniimo you picked. You can change your selection at any time before claiming.
2. The Aniimo you claim will be in Prismana Form, with a randomly generated personality. After you claim it, Phase 2 Prismana Pact will unlock.

3. After Prismana Pact unlocks, Pathfinders can continue collecting Prismana Aniimo within the event’s designated scope. Each time you register a new Prismana Aniimo, it will increase the corresponding Prismana Index completion progress.

4. If the Prismana Aniimo you claimed in Phase 1 is within the Prismana Pact Index scope, it will also count toward your completion progress. Getting the same Prismana Aniimo more than once will not increase progress again.
5. When your Prismana Index completion reaches the required milestones, you can claim the corresponding stage rewards.
6. You can check your current Prismana Aniimo registrations through View Index on the event screen, and keep hunting for Prismana Aniimo you haven’t registered yet.

events.title: Journey Handbook
events.intro: Record every day you travel alongside your Aniimo buddies. Once your total check-in days reach the required amount, you can claim rewards.
rules: 1. During the event, log in to the game each day to complete that day’s check-in and earn rewards based on your cumulative check-in days.
2. The daily check-in count resets at 04:00 (UTC+0). Check in for a total of 30 days to claim all rewards.

events.title: Set Off Together!
events.intro: Unlock the event to immediately receive the Emberpup Set, then log in for a total of 3 days to claim all rewards. (Make a purchase of any amount to activate the event.)
rules: Complete a top-up of any amount (including Monthly Pass, Companion Handbook Advanced Edition, and Collector’s Edition) to unlock the event. Once it’s unlocked, immediately receive the Emberpup Set, and claim all rewards by logging in for 3 cumulative days.

events.title: Aniimo Discovery
events.intro: The Institute has discovered a brand-new Aniimo in Idyll! Go track it down!
rules: 1. The Polaris Institute has discovered a brand-new Aniimo in Idyll and hopes Pathfinders will assist with its investigation and research.
2. Pathfinders can spend search attempts to track the Aniimo across Idyll and catch it.

3. The Institute will periodically replenish free search attempts for Pathfinders to support ongoing exploration. Unused free search attempts cannot be accumulated, so please remember to use them in time.
4. If you currently have no free search attempts remaining, you can spend Vein Essence and search attempts to continue searching.
5. Pathfinders can complete investigation quests related to this Aniimo to earn generous rewards.
6. Based on your investigation quest progress, you can unlock different search bonuses in the Research Center.

events.title: Tracing the Trail: The Shadow of Legend
events.intro: Look out! Mysterious Legendary Aniimo have appeared in many places, sending abnormal surges of Vein Energy rippling across the land. The Institute urgently calls on Pathfinders to gather clues and pinpoint the Legendary Aniimo!
rules: Unusual signs of Legendary Aniimo have begun appearing everywhere. The Institute is recruiting Pathfinders to go investigate, and bring back valuable photos and complete the field notes. Event Details
1. During the event, the Institute will unlock multiple investigation areas over time.
2. Each area has different investigation objectives and environmental features. Dispatch suitable Aniimo to explore them.
3. After completing an investigation, you can obtain the corresponding area rewards and may also receive an extra Chance Encounter Gift. Investigation Rules
1. Each investigation requires at least 2 Aniimo. You must designate 1 as the Leader Aniimo before the investigation.
2. After the investigation is complete, you will receive base rewards according to the dispatched Aniimo. Dispatching Aniimo meeting the area preference conditions increases your reward rating.

3. Prismana Form and Sparkling Aniimo can sense the residual energy of Legendary Aniimo, which will help speed up the investigation. Chance Encounter Gifts When passing through an area with Legendary Aniimo, something special might appear from their energy. After completing an investigation, you also have a chance to receive 1 Chance Encounter Reward. One of the following rewards will be granted at random: - Random Leader Aniimo Potential +1 - Starcryst Essence x1 - Capaseed x5 - Vein Essence x1 ※ The "Random Leader Aniimo Potential +1" effect can only be obtained once in each Aniimo’s lifetime. ※ Aniimo with max Potential cannot obtain the "Random Leader Aniimo Potential +1" effect.

events.title: Glamour Star
events.intro: The Glamour Star Auditions are open! Dress up your Aniimo according to the theme and aim for a high score to become the brightest star!
rules: 1. After the event begins, Polaris Institute will announce the theme for the Glamour Star Auditions.
2. Pathfinders can choose a suitable Aniimo and pair it with accessories based on the current theme to enter the event.
3. The Institute will score each Aniimo based on how well the Aniimo and its accessories match the theme.
4. Reach the required score milestones to claim the corresponding rewards.
5. Each Glamour Star event can be attempted multiple times, but each reward can only be claimed once.

events.title: Hatch Haste
events.intro: From Friday to Sunday, Aniimo egg hatching time is halved!
rules: 1. During the Event, Egg Hatch time is reduced by half.
2. This only affects Hatchinators in the Outpost, Astra, and Home.
3. When the Event begins, the remaining Hatch time for Eggs already being Hatched is cut in half.
4. When the Event ends, the remaining Hatch time for Eggs that have already received the Event Haste bonus will not be affected.
5. If you have the Monthly Pass during the Event, the Event bonus is applied first when you start Hatching, then the Monthly Pass benefits are stacked on top.

events.title: SPARKELF x Aniimo, Meet Your Fire Companion
events.intro: Drawn by the bond between humans and Aniimo, Sparkelf has arrived in Astra from SylphIsle! Keep your Sparks going with friends and make progress in the codex to complete quests, collect Sparks, and exchange them for awesome rewards!
rules: "1. During the event, you can get Sparks through the following ways: · Complete the Fire Companion Codex quest. · Take part in the Continuing Sparks mode. · Check in at the Sparkelf statue in Horizon Square (only once per day).

2. Continuing Sparks mode details: · Each day, interact with friends to light up Sparks. Interactions include: ※ Chat: send messages to each other. ※ Party Up: form a team. ※ Gift: send gifts to each other. ※ Aniimo Exchange: exchange Aniimo. ※ Visit Home: visit each other. · After you light up a Spark, a Spark icon will appear next to your friend’s nickname. The number next to it shows how many days you and that friend have interacted during the event. Once you hit 5 days or more, the Spark icon will also level up. · The Spark icon will gray out after the daily server refresh at 04:00. Interact with your friends to light it up again.

3. Event rewards: · When your personal total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, you can claim personal progress rewards. · When the server-wide total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, all players can claim server-wide progress rewards. · Special Notes: ※ The Sparkelf with the Sparkling Mutation (including the Basic Form and Prismana Form) has a sparkling outline effect, but no partial recolor effect. ※ The Sparkelf (Prismana Form) will be unavailable after the event ends. Please stay tuned for future official announcements."

events.title: Starflash Event, Spud Buddies Assemble
events.intro: GameSpud has landed in Astra, and the limited-time pop-up shop event is now live! Complete check-in and planting quests during the event to earn exclusive rednote collab furniture!
rules: 1. During the Event, complete the "Pop-Up Store Check-In" and "Plant Little Sweet Potatoes" Quests to receive their respective Quest rewards. Complete all Quests to also claim the Xiaohongshu collaboration exclusive furniture item, "A Basket of Sweet Potatoes."

2. Quest Details: ① Pop-Up Store Check-In: Head to the entrance of the Xiaohongshu pop-up store at the northwest corner of the lower level of Horizon Square in Astra. Take a Snap there to complete the check-in Quest. ② Plant Little Sweet Potatoes: Search for "Aniimo" on Xiaohongshu to join the "Aniimo Plants Sweet Potatoes" Event and publish a related post. After approval, you can receive the "Recipe Note: Little Sweet Potato" redemption code on Xiaohongshu. Once obtained, you can plant Little Sweet Potato seeds in your Home and harvest "Captain Spud." If you grow a "Game Spud," you'll also have a chance to win cash and gold prizes on Xiaohongshu~

events.title: Boundless Twining
events.intro: Wherever you are, your bond with your Aniimo never breaks. Log in with the same account on both mobile and PC/console during the event to claim lots of rewards!
rules: 1. During the event, log in with the same game account separately on mobile and PC/console to complete the Cross-Platform Play quest.
2. Both mobile and PC/console logins must use a sign-in method linked to the same account. Logging in with different accounts will not count toward event progress.
3. Once you’ve completed the cross-platform login, you can claim the corresponding Cross-Platform Play reward on the event page.
4. Each game account can complete the Cross-Platform Play quest and claim its reward only once.

events.title: Harvest Moon Festival

events.title: Quick Leveling Guide
rules: The Polaris Institute has put together a handy guide to earning Safaris efficiently while exploring Idyll, to help Pathfinders grow faster. Check it out now!

events.title: Legendary Journey: Departure with the Wind
events.intro: A powerful Legendary Aniimo has been born, drawing Vein energy together and forming a strange energy rift. Yet the Vein is surging abnormally, and the affected Legendary Aniimo has become ferocious. Pathfinder, please explore the energy rift at once. With courage and a healing heart, soothe the out-of-control Aniimo and put an end to this disturbance.

events.title: Star-Crossed Tea Party
events.intro: Now that the busy adventure has come to a pause, why not rest beneath the starlight with your Aniimo?
rules: 1. Every day from 18:00 to 2:00 (UTC+0) the next day, the cafe in Astra hosts the Star-Crossed Tea Party. After a long day on your journey, why not stop by and relax? Chat with passing travelers, share stories from today’s adventure, and you might even meet a new ally along the way.
2. Stay and interact during the tea party to earn Voxel Coins and Season Stamps. Daily Limits: Voxel Coin ×150 Season Stamp ×40

events.title: Holo-Battle Sim
events.intro: Join the Holo-Battle Sim and boost your combat strength! Complete training challenges to claim rewards!
rules: 1. "Holo-Battle Sim" is a solo challenge developed by the Battle Art Department for students. It uses holographic simulations based on documented Aniimo of various kinds, together with training robots.
2. Each element’s Holo-Battle Sim is divided into 4 difficulties. Each difficulty offers "First Clear Rewards" and "Training Incentives".

3. "First Clear Rewards" can only be claimed once per season, upon clearing the corresponding difficulty. "Training Incentives" refresh weekly. Clearing the highest difficulty lets you claim the "Training Incentives" for all lower difficulties as well.

events.title: Operation: Egg Heist
events.intro: Head to the Lost Isles, search for rare Eggs, and evacuate with them successfully!
rules: 1. Head to the Lost Isles, search the ruins for rare Eggs, and evacuate by boat!

events.title: Holo-Battle Interlink
events.intro: Team up in a four-player squad, take on powerful Aniimo in a holographic simulation, earn rewards, and climb the leaderboard!
rules: 1. Holo-Battle Interlink is a four-person team challenge designed by the Battle Art Department. Using the data from the most powerful Aniimo ever as a blueprint, the challenge employs holographic simulation technology to create scenarios for trainees. Teams that complete the challenge will receive rewards and be ranked based on their performance rating.

2. The system records the highest star rank achieved during the current period, unlocks the corresponding rewards based on that best star rank, and grants those rewards upon settlement when you exit the mode.

events.title: Mysterious Vendor

rules: 1. The Mysterious Vendor restocks daily at 04:00 AM (UTC+0), so don’t forget to stop by!

rules: 1. Refunded test rewards can only be claimed by test accounts that meet eligibility requirements.
2. Log in to the event screen with the corresponding account to claim your rewards.
3. After claiming, check your corresponding character to receive them.
4. For more info, view the rules on the event screen.

events.title: Polaris Liaison Station
rules: 1. During the event, visit the "Polaris Liaison Station" and follow the instructions on the event page to link the specified account or platform.
2. Available linking options may vary by region. Please refer to the event page for your region to see which accounts and platforms are currently supported.

3. Your linking quest is considered complete once the account is successfully linked and verified. Make sure the account information you provide is correct to avoid issues with future login or account access.
4. Once the account is successfully linked, the corresponding rewards will be sent via in-game mail. Be sure to check your mailbox.

5. Quest completion status and available rewards are based on what is shown on the event page. If you have completed the linking process but haven’t received your rewards, try logging into the game again or contact official Support.
6. Event times, supported platforms, and rewards may vary by region or platform. Please refer to the in-game information for details.

events.title: Official Community
events.intro: Receive a reward for each official community account you follow!
rules: 1. During the event, Pathfinders can claim the corresponding reward for each official community they follow!
2. Each follow reward can only be claimed once per official community.

events.title: Journey Moments
events.intro: Every encounter along the way is worth treasuring. Log in for the required number of days during the event to claim your travel gifts, and build your own collection of special moments with your Aniimo partners!
rules: 1. During the event, log in to the game each day to complete that day’s check-in and earn rewards based on your cumulative check-in count.
2. The daily check-in count resets at 04:00 (UTC+0). Check in for a total of 7 days to claim all rewards.

events.title: Idyll Ecology Field Notes
events.intro: The Institute has discovered that some Aniimo are affected by the Sea of Flowers and can take on unique forms. Head out and investigate the designated Aniimo to help the Institute record their ecological changes!
rules: 1. During the event, Polaris Institute will publish an Ecological Investigation. Each investigation focuses on a single ecological theme and selects a range of representative Aniimo as investigation targets.
2. Pathfinders must follow the investigation list and catch the corresponding Aniimo to help the Institute complete its ecological investigation and earn Investigation Points.
3. Each target Aniimo only grants points the first time its investigation is completed. Catching the same target again will not grant additional points.
4. Please pay close attention to Aniimo forms. Only catching an Aniimo in the same form as listed on the investigation list will complete the corresponding investigation.
5. Once your accumulated Investigation Points reach the specified requirements, you can claim the corresponding milestone rewards.
6. If the investigation target is an Aniimo the Pathfinder has not yet registered in the Aniilog, the points earned for completing its investigation for the first time will be doubled.

events.title: Who’s That Aniimo?
events.intro: Study the silhouette, gather the clues, and guess the mystery Aniimo!
rules: 1. Once the event begins, Polaris Institute will reveal this period’s mystery Aniimo silhouette.

2. The initial silhouette will only show the mystery Aniimo’s distinctive features, with the remaining parts hidden. Pathfinders can reveal the hidden parts by photographing Aniimo that share the same features as the mystery Aniimo.

3. Photograph an Aniimo matching the silhouette’s corresponding form and submit it to complete the research topic and claim the corresponding rewards. Successfully photographing before the full silhouette is revealed earns you bonus Aniimo Observation Rewards!

4. Pathfinders can also select photos from their existing album that meet the topic requirements for submission. If a photo contains this period’s mystery Aniimo, it counts toward event completion too.
5. Pay attention to Aniimo forms — only photos where the submitted Aniimo matches the mystery Aniimo’s exact form will count toward event completion.
6. Pathfinders can complete the event by photographing their own Aniimo, other players’ Aniimo, or wild Aniimo on the continent of Idyll.
7. Aniimo in the Holo-Battle Sim are holographic projections, and Aniimo found in Sanctums are bound by ancient seals. Photos taken in these two locations cannot be recognized or submitted.
